semantic_votes.rationale: Repair changes the material and diff boundary, so validation and review of the superseded state cannot support implementation closure.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: The rule is confined to implementation closure; Core marks stale-after-edit evidence and unreviewed changed scope as fail-closed non-completion outcomes.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Keep closure nonterminal until post-repair validation and review of the latest changed scope are current.

semantic_votes.rationale: The complete seven-control set preserves authority, safety, formal evidence, targeted validation, independent review, and current completion evidence at every routed level.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: Canonical Core enumerates exactly seven non_bypassable controls and L1 retains them all; build and install exact validation provide the stated trust anchor.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Retain build-install exact validation, the malformed-artifact integrity fallback, and the explicit runtime limits on coordinated tampering and unknown IDs.

semantic_votes.rationale: One completed path per canonical identity prevents same-path validation loops, while the adjacent gap-or-transition clause admits justified additional evidence paths.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: Core validation_loop sets complete_path_limit to one within the validation identity and requires a bound gap or verifiable state transition for another path.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Keep the adjacent exception clause and block repeated completed paths without a canonical uncovered gap or evidence transition.

semantic_votes.rationale: A single primary Skill gives each routed task one responsibility and output authority, while optional Layer 3 guidance covers bounded supporting concerns.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: The current router routes once per task with one primary Professional Skill; source-free direct answers and utility no-edit work are separately excluded from normal Skill loading.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Preserve route-once assignment and prevent task agents from rerouting or chaining competing primary Professional Skills over the same scope.

semantic_votes.rationale: Writing a diff export into the workspace would mutate the reviewed change set, defeating supplied-artifact scope integrity and no-edit evidence.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: This path applies only when supplied-artifact mode lacks a diff; Core utility rules require diff-export/no-edit output as supplied content or a host-native artifact.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Preserve identical before-and-after workspace checks and invalidate downstream review or closure when comparison evidence changes or is unavailable.

semantic_votes.rationale: Formal readiness asserts a stronger evidence boundary, so ordinary authoring validation cannot substantiate that claim without dedicated formal evidence gates.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: Core makes formal evidence non-bypassable when formal readiness is declared and repeats that condition as validation_loop.formal_scope_rule.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Keep formal readiness fail closed until the repository's formal-release evidence succeeds against the final material tree.

limitations: This independent ballot is static source-contract review; it does not prove real-host startup, runtime routing behavior, production enforcement, coordinated-tamper detection, or installed user experience.
The review covers only the six packet-named Main Root targets and their current source and Core authority context; it does not satisfy readability or professional-completeness formal attestations.
